campaign.title: CleanEnergy Consumer Carbon Tracking Web App MVP
campaign.description: Develop an interactive web portal where residential users can calculate their household carbon savings and track solar ROI. Includes user dashboard, carbon calculation engine, and responsive mobile-friendly UI.
campaign.project_outcome: Functional MVP deployed with user authentication, calculator form, and interactive charts.
requirements: Interactive savings calculator with live calculation graphs
Responsive mobile and desktop UI matching GreenTech brand guidelines
Clean GitHub repository with setup README and deployment instructions

campaign.title: National Launch: Cold Brew Series TikTok & IG Campaign
campaign.description: Execute a month-long social media activation across TikTok and Instagram for the launch of our bottled cold brew series targeting university students and young professionals.
campaign.campaign_objective: Drive 50,000+ targeted organic views and 1,000+ coupon redemptions across Klang Valley campuses.
requirements: Content calendar with 8 ready-to-post short-form video reels
Hooks, scripts, and editing tailored to Malaysian university culture
Campaign analytics report summarizing engagement, reach, and redemption metrics

campaign.title: Automated Dispatch & Driver Assignment Internal Dashboard
campaign.description: Build an internal operations dashboard to replace manual spreadsheets for route scheduling and driver assignments. Connects to existing shipment API and displays real-time dispatch status.
campaign.project_outcome: Fast, operational internal dashboard allowing dispatchers to assign jobs and review delivery status in one view.
requirements: Dispatcher dashboard with filterable shipment list and driver assignment modal
Role-based access (Operations Manager vs Driver view)
Exportable daily dispatch summary report (CSV / PDF)
